name: Yuuwaku Bunny to Yoru no Recipe
original_name: 誘惑バニーと夜のレシピ
source:
"Mmm, you're big down there... What could YOU want?"

This is a novel-style game based on the voice drama by Sounova. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE174667.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
「嗯……你下面真大……你想要什麼呢？」

一款根據Sounova廣播劇改編的小說式遊戲。

[來源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE174667.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
